PRODUCT_NAME: Thermo Scientific Ampoule with 0.5 ml concentrated nitric acid as preservative
DESCRIPTION:
Thermo Scientific™ Chemical Preservative Glass Ampoules are pre-mixed and measured chemical solutions for the preservation of environmental samples.
Thermo Scientific glass ampoules are machine-welded for a more consistent, leak-tight seal. The 1 mL and 2 mL ampoules both have special sized necks for easier dispensing of the preservative solution. All Thermo Scientific preservatives are shipped in compliance with 49 CFR Part 173.4 DOT Small Quantities.

• Glass ampoule containing a pre-measured aliquot of preservative chemical solution
• Ampoules are machine-welded closed after filling for a consistent, leak-tight seal

DESCRIPTION:
70% USP Isopropyl Alcohol and 30% USP Water for Injection, 16 oz Attached Trigger Spray

DECON-AHOL WFI Formula is an EPA registered sanitizer and disinfectant.
